_note: One of the 20 sets of ichava/icon-sets-extras, each refreshed by its own config into files/<set>/ and licenses/<set>/, with its version recorded at upstream.sets.<set>.current_version in the pack's config.json. <contributor>/<name>.svg kept, one directory per contributor, so every icon stays attributable. badges/ and various-artists/ are excluded: license.txt does not name them, so no licence is stated for them. license.txt is the project's own CC-BY-3.0 statement rather than the CC text, so it is pinned by SHA-256. Upstream has no tags, so the version is a commit. Reproduces the committed pack byte for byte: a dry run at the pinned version against the local checkout on 2026-11-04 wrote 4,178 SVGs with 0 added, removed or changed.
name: icon-sets-extras.game-icons
